name: To Ashes raises Demonfire-spending abilities' crit chance by 5% (#2470)
contract: To Ashes 705000 reads 'Increases the critical strike chance of abilities that spend Demonfire by 5%' (bindmysoul.com/conquest/talents.normalized.json, fetchedAt 2026-07-22T23:10:31.369Z; matches the client's own moa_description). Its own baked SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE effect only overlaps a few of the eleven Demonfire-spending root spells enumerated by AscensionXoroth::Spender() - the same under-coverage wave C already found and fixed for Murderous Might (520290, #1242) with the identical remedy: AscensionXorothContracts.cpp nulls the native effect, and xoroth_casts::OnSpellCritChance (AscensionXorothAbilities.cpp) now adds Amount(705000) = 5 to the chance whenever Spender(spell->GetSpellInfo()) is true and the caster has aura 705000, covering every spender uniformly regardless of classmask. Melt (803334) is a self-contained Spender root (single spell ID, no rank chain) chosen so the fix is exercised directly; the native crit-chance query used here (spell_done_crit_chance) resolves the same ALLSPELLHOOK_ON_CRIT_CHANCE path a real cast would.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
CONTRACT: Melt's crit chance rises by 5 percentage points
REGRESSION: a non-Spender family spell (Gore) is untouched
